summary: preinstall hook drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs on `npm install`. setup.mjs is identifier-obfuscated and downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip to a temp directory, extracts it, chmod +x's the bun binary, and then executes a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` under that freshly downloaded runtime. math_init.js is a ~728 KB single-line obfuscated payload using a rotated string/opcode array and a shifter function (obfuscator.io / VM-style), invoked at install time through the dropped Bun binary rather than the installer's Node interpreter — an alternate-runtime-dropper pattern that evades Node-focused scanners. The plugin's advertised purpose (a small babel visitor in lib/index.js unrelated to Bun) is inconsistent with the shipped preinstall dropper and opaque payload, matching a hijacked / impersonated release of the upstream ornikar babel plugin.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
